about_the_game:
Eat Up the Whole Stage! Chomp & Grow: A Zesty Party Action Game - MASS of GREED

Team up with Guguri, monsters born from human greed, to save a planet suffering from an energy crisis! Open wide and chomp down on towns and houses to grow massive, and generate tons of energy! Sometimes you'll super-size, other times you'll transform – just keep on joyfully eating everything in sight!

Devour Every Last Bit!

With simple button controls, you can happily gobble up everything on the stage! Guguri get bigger with every tasty bite, so keep on chomping and growing! Stages are procedurally generated, so no two are ever the same! You might discover something new every time you play.

Play with Friends!

Team up in 2-player mode and eat together! Cooperate or compete! Experience an exhilarating party action game where desires clash!

The Secret of the Lab

Uncover the hidden truth behind the giant corporation that created Guguri! You might even find fellow Guguri somewhere in the world!

Customize Your Guguri!

Use the energy you collect to customize your Guguri's appearance and abilities!

This game is for players who want to enjoy "time together" with family and friends, regardless of their gaming skill or age!

*Please note: This game is currently under development. Content may change.
